verdict.rationale: NetHunt's own marketing states that users can launch automated actions on any change in CRM fields or user activity, move pipeline stages on trigger events, and customize automations. That is direct event-triggered rule automation. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the rule builder (conditions, available action types, branching), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond homepage claims.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Launch automated actions based on any change in Sales CRM fields or user activity.
Adjust stages of the pipeline based on any trigger event.
Modify fields, pipeline stages, views, and automations to match your unique processes.
